title: Finite-parts presentation of a pulled-back sheaf with proper support
statement:
Let $f:X\to S$ be a separated quasi-finite morphism of finite presentation between Noetherian schemes [def-pc-scheme, pqf-def-quasifinite, def-sbc-locally-finite-presentation, def-weil-proper-morphism, def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring]. Here Noetherian means admitting a finite affine cover by spectra of Noetherian rings. Let $B$ be a commutative ring, and let $F,G$ be sheaves of $B$-modules on the small etale site $S_{\mathrm{et}}$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-site, def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaves]. Write $f^*$ for inverse image [def-weil-pbc-inverse-image]. For a sheaf $H$ on $X_{\mathrm{et}}$, let $f_!^{\mathrm{supp}}H\subset f_*H$ be the sheaf whose sections on $U\to S$ have support proper over $U$, as in [lem-cbc-proper-support-sheaf-composition, def-weil-pbc-direct-image].

A finite-parts decomposition over an etale $U\to S$ of finite presentation consists of a finite pointed set $(I,0)$ and an open-and-closed disjoint decomposition $X\times_SU=\coprod_{i\in I}V_i$, where $v_i:V_i\to U$ is finite for $i\ne0$ [def-pc-fibre-product, def-weil-finite-integral-morphism, def-weil-open-immersion]. The piece $V_0$ need not be finite. There is a canonical map
$$\eta_\phi:(F|_U)^{\oplus(I\setminus\{0\})}\longrightarrow (f_!^{\mathrm{supp}}f^*F)|_U$$
whose $i$-th component is the adjunction unit $F|_U\to v_{i*}v_i^*(F|_U)$ followed by inclusion as sections supported on the clopen finite piece $V_i$.

For a refinement $\phi'$ of $\phi$ specified by a pointed map $\sigma:I'\to I$ with $V_i=\coprod_{\sigma(j)=i}V'_j$ for every $i$, let $t_\sigma:F^{\oplus(I\setminus\{0\})}|_U\to F^{\oplus(I'\setminus\{0\})}|_U$ send a tuple $a$ to the tuple with $j$-th entry $a_{\sigma(j)}$ if $\sigma(j)\ne0$, and $0$ otherwise. Then $\eta_\phi=\eta_{\phi'}t_\sigma$.

These generators and relations give the following presentation: composing with all $\eta_\phi$ is a bijection between $B$-linear sheaf morphisms $f_!^{\mathrm{supp}}f^*F\to G$ and families of $B$-linear maps $g_\phi:F^{\oplus(I\setminus\{0\})}|_U\to G|_U$ compatible with all etale restrictions and satisfying $g_\phi=g_{\phi'}t_\sigma$ for every refinement. Equivalently this is a colimit presentation in the etale-local sense; one can work on a small skeleton of the basis of finite-presentation etale objects. The generators commute with change of base under the proper-support comparison and with homomorphisms of coefficient rings.

For every geometric point $\bar s$ of $S$ there is a pointed etale neighbourhood $U$ of finite presentation and such a decomposition for which $(V_0)_{\bar s}$ is empty and every $(V_i)_{\bar s}$ for $i\ne0$ has exactly one geometric point. The stalk of $\eta_\phi$ at this point is the isomorphism from one copy of $F_{\bar s}$ per point of $X_{\bar s}$ onto $(f_!^{\mathrm{supp}}f^*F)_{\bar s}$ [def-weil-geometric-point, def-weil-pbc-geometric-stalks].
